title: Girl Acts Like an Entitled Brat After Mom Calls Police on Her
description:
On July 14th, 2023, Officers were dispatched in response to a caller who stated that her daughter broke a window in their house. The female was detained for being aggressive. One of the officers then checked the female’s possessions, while the other officer spoke to the victim. The female was agitated and continued cussing at the officer and her own family. After confirming the charges and the evidence, the officers proceeded to transport the female to jail. The female was charged with criminal damage to property, resisting or obstructing a peace officer, and aggravated battery on a peace officer.
